items.title: Joseph "Fan" Bourgeau Interview, 1959-09-24
items.q: I think his name is Paul Anderson. He's a songster.

ctx.x: Well, around Tom Alberts there next door. I don't think he's there now, somebody told me. I'm not sure, I have to check with Tom and Mark.
Now there's, now I don't know if you know this guy, he's, what is this boy's name? His name is Paul Anderson. I think his name is Paul Anderson. He's a songster.
No, I don't think I know him.
